sources.notes: Road surfaces are triangulated directly between this layout's saved road boundaries. Elevation follows the approximately 76 m terrain raster, not a survey of the road. Curbs are geometry-based illustrations on curved boundaries; their locations, widths, heights and colours are assumed, not extracted from imagery. Banking is unknown. The source is an open route or branch network, without one validated closed driving order. Choose an embedded component route for playback and recording; this network does not represent a single lap. Boundary coordinates and their separate feature-level licence are preserved. Imagery loads externally on demand; no image bytes or meshes are stored.

notes: This component reuses the existing pinned independent course recipe from us-reno-fernley-a-a14b2d9b/reno-fernley-a without changing any source nodes or branch selections. It is included in the aggregate entry for the same venue. The existing draft branch identification, historical alignment and distance limitations remain in force; the identification URL establishes the venue and is not a claim of a current certified lap. Exact source coordinates are unchanged; historical alignment and direction remain provisional.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 76 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
